learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose 75% against About 94% and Impossible over 100%; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Perfect efficacy at 75% coverage showed R 1.00. Clicked efficacy 80%: needed 93.8%, current 75% coverage R 1.60. End on coverage slider set 100%, R 0.80. Efficacy 70% then showed even 100% coverage R 1.20, not enough alone.
observations.reveal: Corrected to About 94%; explained 0.75/0.8 = 0.9375. Acknowledged 70% efficacy requiring 107% coverage and R 1.2 at full coverage. Caveated random mixing, made-up disease and initial outbreak R.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 × 936 screenshot inspected: dot town shows vaccination fill as protection; clear full-coverage limit status and two sliders; full reveal visible.

prediction.reason: Clear alternatives distinguish unchanged coverage from adjusted and impossible thresholds.

interaction.reason: Efficacy and coverage contrasts expose weaker protection and impossible limit.
interaction.evidence: 80% efficacy at 75% coverage R 1.60; full coverage R 0.80; 70% full R 1.20.

payoff.reason: Relates actual state to division and full-coverage limit with assumptions.

clarity.reason: Labels, feedback and limit badge make tested desktop path clear.

transfer.reason: Reusable division rule and conditions offered without concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Coverage depends on R0 and efficacy; toy limits.

accessibility.reason: One slider endpoint key is insufficient access audit.
accessibility.evidence: End worked on coverage; focus order, contrast, phone, zoom and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: Committed unchanged threshold contradicted by 93.8% requirement.

visualExplanation.reason: Dot fill depicts weaker protection and coverage limit.
visualExplanation.evidence: Full vaccinated dot town with R 1.20.

playfulness.reason: Two controls support contrasting coverage and efficacy.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete threshold interpretation within toy model.

depth.reason: Efficacy scaling and saturation boundary both central.

complexity.reason: Links coverage times efficacy to effective protection and threshold.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Two linked proportional relations and 100% coverage limit.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low: two labeled sliders and preset buttons.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: moderate: percentages, decimal division and R.

whyCool: With everyone vaccinated, dropping efficacy from 80% to 70% visibly pushes R from 0.8 to 1.2.
caveat: One fixed R0; no fresh disease application or full accessibility audit.
missingEvidence: Focus order, contrast, phone, zoom/reflow and motion untested.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
